runtimeClaimsNotProven: Unity-managed Worker execution and Domain Reload recovery
Feishu authentication, tenant permissions and network responses
timeout, cancellation, retry, rate-limit and circuit-breaker behavior
redaction, cache freshness and incremental synchronization behavior

runtimeEscalation.reason: Only a fresh authorized managed run can prove Feishu authentication, network reads and process lifecycle behavior.

caseAssertions.normal-input: the three allowed operations route to es.feishu.read@1 through AIBrain and the facade
caseAssertions.invalid-input: unknown operations, malformed fields and out-of-range bounds are rejected
caseAssertions.denied-expansion: direct CLI, credential input, remote mutation, path expansion and Assets writes are denied
caseAssertions.repeat-idempotency: InvocationId reuse is accepted only for the same normalized invocation hash
caseAssertions.hash-change-cache-invalidation: command, task, worker, Skill or governance drift invalidates stale plans and evidence
caseAssertions.interruption-recovery: timeout, cancellation and Domain Reload have explicit terminal-evidence requirements
caseAssertions.deterministic-output: normalized results, SourceRefs and receipts use bounded fields and stable identities

responsibilityScope: Static acceptance of the managed Feishu read workflow; it does not prove external connectivity or Unity process behavior.

specializedAcceptance.title: managed Feishu read workflow static gate
specializedAcceptance.runtimeBoundary: Static acceptance cannot prove Feishu credentials, tenant permissions, network I/O, managed process termination, Domain Reload or cache behavior.
